rows.sentence: Here are tips from the document ("Money Management Tips: 55 Ways to Save Money"), grouped by the document's categories:
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The title and all seven category headings match those in the document.

rows.sentence: Instead of paying for a fitness club membership fee, buy some weights or go to the ARC.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document names both alternatives to paying for a fitness club membership.

rows.sentence: When eating out, look for coupons or special deals- many restaurants offer them!
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document recommends looking for coupons or deals and says many restaurants offer them.

rows.sentence: Bring your student ID when you go out for a movie.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document explicitly recommends bringing a student ID to the movies.

rows.sentence: Most theaters will give discount for students.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document says most theaters give students a discount.

rows.sentence: Ask for generic medications at the pharmacy.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document explicitly recommends asking for generic medications at the pharmacy.

rows.sentence: Don't buy bottled water.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document advises against buying bottled water.

rows.sentence: Buy a water filtration pitcher.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document recommends buying a water filtration pitcher.

rows.sentence: Make home cooked meals.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document recommends preparing meals at home.

rows.sentence: A home cooked stead dinner is often cheaper than a fast food binge.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document makes the same cost comparison, including the apparent typo.

rows.sentence: Pack a lunch instead of eating out.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document explicitly recommends packing lunch instead of eating out.

rows.sentence: Buy clothes at the end of the season when they're on sales.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document recommends buying clothes during end-of-season sales.

rows.sentence: Invest in durable clothes, shoes, etc. rather than buying many cheap pairs.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document recommends durable clothing and shoes over buying many cheap pairs.

rows.sentence: Set goals for your spending and saving.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document explicitly recommends setting both spending and saving goals.

rows.sentence: Keep track of your spending to avoid overspent.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document recommends tracking spending to avoid overspending and uses the same wording.

rows.sentence: There are apps for that!
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document says apps are available for tracking spending.

rows.sentence: Wait at least two hours before making a big purchase to be sure it's something you really need.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document gives both the two-hour minimum and the reason for waiting.

rows.sentence: Keep your tires inflated properly- you'll get better gas mileage.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document recommends proper tire inflation and links it to better gas mileage.

rows.sentence: Carpool with friend!
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document explicitly recommends carpooling with a friend.

rows.sentence: Look around for cheapest gas price before filling up.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document recommends looking for the cheapest gas before filling up.

rows.sentence: There are apps for that!
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document says apps are available for finding the cheapest gas price.

rows.sentence: Only use ATM's of your bank.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document recommends using only ATMs belonging to your own bank.

rows.sentence: Other bank's ATM fees add up!
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document explicitly says that other banks' ATM fees add up.

rows.sentence: Always put part of our paycheck into a savings account.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document recommends always depositing part of a paycheck into savings.

rows.sentence: Spare change adds up!
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document explicitly says that spare change adds up.

rows.sentence: Get a piggy bank or change jar and don't underestimate the value of your spare changes.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document recommends a piggy bank or change jar and advises readers not to underestimate their spare change.

rows.sentence: Unplug electronics when you aren't using them.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document recommends unplugging electronics when they are not in use.

rows.sentence: Even while turned off, they still use up costly energy.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document says electronics still use costly energy when turned off.

rows.sentence: Pay your bills online.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document explicitly recommends paying bills online.

rows.sentence: Save paper and money on stamps.
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The document identifies saving paper and money on stamps as benefits of paying bills online.
